description: This file defines the ErrorHandlingMiddleware class, which is an ASP.NET Core middleware component responsible for global exception handling, logging errors, and returning JSON error responses.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that intercepts HTTP requests to handle exceptions globally, log errors, and send JSON error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: The middleware method that invokes the next delegate in the pipeline and catches exceptions to handle them.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Private static method to handle exceptions by setting response status, logging, and serializing error messages.
